note: Live run captured after the AlphaFold provider fix (CHANGELOG.md, Unreleased) but BEFORE the StructureResult.recovered fix that the same run's output exposed. AlphaFold retrieval jumped from 0% (see structure_benchmark_2026-09-21_prefix_summary.json) to 98.5%, confirming the provider fix. The per_provider.alphafold.recovered_after_failure value below (67) is the raw, INCORRECT value produced by the buggy StructureResult.recovered property -- it reports every one of the 67 successful AlphaFold retrievals as a recovery, which is implausible on its face (no service fails on attempt 1 and recovers on attempt 2 for 100% of 67 unrelated proteins) and was in fact caused by AlphaFold's two-call design (API discovery + file download) being miscounted as a retry. It is left unedited here as the authentic record of what the run produced; do not cite it. A clean re-run with both fixes applied is needed before citing any recovered_after_failure figure for AlphaFold, and should replace this file.

alphafold.recovered_after_failure_note: Known incorrect -- see top-level note. Should be 0 or close to it under the corrected StructureResult.recovered definition.
